purpose: Read-only step 01 baseline and source-chain inventory; not a scientific run or a data-access approval.

source_tree.representation: Git blob bytes; not the working-tree source_tree_sha256 of any historical run
source_tree.hash_recipe: SHA256 of sorted UTF8 path + NUL + Git blob bytes + NUL

replacement_boundaries.name: reference_argument_query
replacement_boundaries.finding: Reference target IDs are encoded into retrieval queries and used by candidate construction. Noise and downstream removal of reference_spec do not establish upstream independence.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Replace the source of matching evidence and the candidate builder for the new observation contract.

replacement_boundaries.name: student_argument_encoding
replacement_boundaries.finding: Student argument features compare existing ID-derived vectors with node/edge/place queries. Role encoding retains these inputs; it does not directly add merge_queries.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Keep role semantics only after rebuilding features from allowed observations; do not reuse old dimensions or checkpoints by assumption.

replacement_boundaries.name: executed_future_teacher
replacement_boundaries.finding: Candidate branches are advanced using registered reference policies/programs and compared with reference_states.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Replace future advancement/correspondence and scoring evidence for real observations; retain immutable execution and separate energy terms.

replacement_boundaries.name: direct_future_and_no_execution_targets
replacement_boundaries.finding: C/E future targets are read from reference future states, not from candidate post-world execution.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Adapt C/E targets to the same permitted future observations; preserve this method distinction and fair supervision.

replacement_boundaries.name: label_and_training_rows
replacement_boundaries.finding: Training rows include audit steps and registered recovery examples; y is reference_program_index.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Review valid-answer sets, evidence semantics and state sampling before new training.

replacement_boundaries.name: versioned_foundation
replacement_boundaries.finding: Existing versioned execution is a reuse candidate, not proof of numerical latent update support.
replacement_boundaries.disposition: Revalidate with tensor/cache immutability and evidence reassignment after the new state contract.

historical_run_binding_policy: Reports remain bound to their embedded original code/data/config provenance; this inventory does not replace their markers or claim remote arrays/checkpoints are present.
limits: Static code reading and hashes only; no new statistical, recovery, or execution result.
No source-backed claim of server file presence.
Public training scan IDs alone do not establish reference/rescan scene grouping.
function_hash_recipe: SHA256 of UTF8 function lines from line through end_line inclusive, preserving trailing LF from the Git blob
